overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the October 31, 2013 morning and afternoon meetings were not serial deliberation by a quorum, and the afternoon sub-quorum meeting was not an unposted subcommittee. Matter closed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the Board serially deliberated by holding two consecutive sub-quorum meetings on October 31, 2013, without notice.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the two meetings did not constitute serial deliberation in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Alternatively alleged that the afternoon October 31, 2013 meeting of two Board members with a private party was an unposted subcommittee meeting.
allegations.key_passage: This ad hoc meeting of less than a quorum of the Board's members did not constitute a subcommittee.
